abstract: CAPSULE: Authors report a case of a 52-year-old woman after struma ovarii with chronic lymphocytic inflammation excision. Finally thyroxin treatment was started and patient's hypothyroidism symptoms diminished. CASE SUMMARY: Struma ovarii is a type of mature teratoma in which thyroid tissue forms the main component. In most cases struma ovarii is composed of normal thyroid tissue while lymphocytic thyroiditis in struma ovarii occurs very rarely. The authors report a case of a 52-year-old woman after ovarian tumor excision. In histopatholgical examination struma ovarii with chronic lymphocytic inflammation was diagnosed. Additional studies revealed a typical ultrasonographic picture of Hashimoto disease in the thyroid gland and an increased concentration of thyroglobulin antibodies. A final diagnosis of Hashimoto disease was confirmed. Initially, thyroid gland function was normal but 11 months after surgery, supplementation therapy with thyroxin was administered. In this case, an early diagnosis of Hashimoto disease resulted from excision of struma ovarii with chronic lymphocytic inflammation. It induced early thyroxin treatment and allowed to reduce hypothyroidism symptoms.
abstract_ja: カプセル：52歳女性で、慢性リンパ球性炎症を伴う卵巣甲状腺腫の切除後の症例を報告する。最終的にチロキシン補充療法を開始し、甲状腺機能低下症の症状は軽快した。症例の要約：52歳女性が卵巣腫瘍の切除後に来院した。病理組織学的検査で、慢性リンパ球性炎症を伴う卵巣甲状腺腫と診断された。追加検査で甲状腺の超音波検査における典型的なハシモト病の所見と、甲状腺グロブリン抗体の上昇が認められた。最終的にハシモト病と診断された。術当初は甲状腺機能は正常であったが、術後11か月でチロキシンによる補充療法が開始された。本症例では、慢性リンパ球性炎症を伴う卵巣甲状腺腫の切除により、ハシモト病の早期診断が得られた。これにより早期のチロキシン治療が可能となり、甲状腺機能低下症の症状を軽減できた。
